text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 171, October 18, 1938 ]
CREATING A NATIONAL FIRE PREVENTION BOARD
WHEREAS every year fires occur in some sections of the country rendering people homeless and destitute;
WHEREAS fires have wrought damages not only to the people directly affected but also to the whole country
amounting to several million pesos; and
WHEREAS the planning and study of efficient and modern methods of preventing the tremendous waste
resulting from fires are necessary to insure the safety of the people and the protection of their properties;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, MANUEL L. QUEZON, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers in me
vested by law, do hereby constitute and create a National Fire Prevention Board to be composed of a chairman
and four members who shall be appointed by the President of the Philippines from time to time.
The board which shall meet at the call of the Chairman shall have the following duties:
(a) To investigate the origin and cause of fires;
(b) To study ways and means of preventing and fighting fires;
(c) To arouse the inhabitants of the Philippines to the necessity of combating and preventing fires by
appealing to their sense of individual responsibility through the newspapers, radio, posters, or other means of
dissemination;
(d) To coöperate with the authorities concerned in the adoption of such measures as may be necessary for the
effective supervision and regulation of the manufacture, distribution, storage, and possession of petroleum,
gas, acetylene, dynamite, gunpowder, explosives, blasting supplies, or ingredients thereof, and other highly
combustible matter;
(e) To cause the inspection of factory buildings, and other structures which are considered lire hazards and
recommend to the proper authorities their removal or their remodelling so as to provide sufficient protection
against fire;
(f) To encourage the observance in every municipality and chartered city of Fire Prevention Week proclaim in
Proclamation Numbered Two hundred forty-eight, dated January twentieth, nineteen hundred and thirty-eight;
(g) To submit from time to lime to the President of the Philippines its recommendations on fire prevention.
